text:
On the (un)usefulness of things

A

        scarecrow,

        in the middle of a summer-scorched sea of wheat,

        watches over no one

        consciously.

        But it is not useless, for it takes care of absence.

translation.title: On the (Un)usefulness of Things
translation.editorial_note: The source catalog title differs, but the displayed poem is 'Sobre la in(utilidad) de las cosas,' translated here by the body title.
